## Post-deploy IndexNow ping (production only)

**NOT imported into or tested on a running n8n instance.** Written from n8n documentation and source.

A signed webhook from the deploy pipeline starts this. The workflow checks the signature, refuses to run unless SITE_BASE_URL is the production host (PRODUCTION_HOST), reads the sitemap, and tells IndexNow (Bing family, Yandex, Seznam, Naver, Yep; not Google) which URLs exist.

**Instance requirement:** the Code node needs `NODE_FUNCTION_ALLOW_BUILTIN=crypto` (and the same allowance on the task runner if task runners are used), and `$env` access must be allowed (`N8N_BLOCK_ENV_ACCESS_IN_NODE=false`).

**Caller contract:** POST the JSON body with headers `x-ablepoint-timestamp` (Unix seconds) and `x-ablepoint-signature` (hex HMAC-SHA256 of `<timestamp>.<raw body>`, optional `sha256=` prefix). Optional body field `paths`: array of changed paths. This is the scheme in packages/automation/src/webhook.ts. A plain Vercel webhook does not sign this way, so a small signing relay is needed (not built).

Environment variables: SITE_BASE_URL, PRODUCTION_HOST, INDEXNOW_KEY, DEPLOY_WEBHOOK_SECRET, NOTIFY_FROM_ADDRESS, ALERT_NOTIFY_ADDRESS.
